stories.title: Why You Forget Why You Entered a Room

scenes.visual_prompt: Anime-style character stepping into a doorway. As they pause, tiny glowing memory sparks drift away from their head. Soft pastel colors, fantasy anime style, 720p.
scenes.narration: Ever forget why you entered a room?

scenes.visual_prompt: Anime fantasy hallway filled with floating glowing memory orbs. Some orbs flicker and disappear as the camera moves forward. Magical anime atmosphere, 720p.
Surreal anime visualization of a glowing memory thread snapping as it crosses a floating doorway in darkness. Slow dramatic motion, fantasy anime lighting, 720p.
scenes.narration: Crossing a doorway can reset what you were thinking.

scenes.visual_prompt: Anime medium shot of the character turning back slowly with a confused expression. Bright colors, expressive eyes, 720p.

stories.title: Why Time Feels Faster at Night

scenes.visual_prompt: Anime-style close-up of a character checking their phone at night. Neon clock symbols briefly glow behind them. Night colors, anime shading, 720p.
scenes.narration: Why does time fly at night?

scenes.visual_prompt: Anime fantasy scene of floating glowing clocks melting into starry darkness. Smooth motion, dreamlike anime style, 720p.
scenes.narration: Your brain measures time using memories.

scenes.visual_prompt: Surreal anime timeline made of glowing fragments shrinking and stretching in space. Calm flowing motion, fantasy aesthetic, 720p.
scenes.narration: At night, fewer memories form, so time feels shorter.

scenes.visual_prompt: Anime medium shot of the character looking surprised at the late hour. Soft glow fades, night colors remain, 720p.

stories.title: Why Your Body Jerks Before Sleep

scenes.visual_prompt: Anime character lying in bed, eyes closing. Shadow beneath them briefly stretches downward like falling. Dreamy anime style, 720p.
scenes.narration: Ever feel your body jump before sleep?

scenes.visual_prompt: Anime fantasy silhouette of a character gently falling through glowing stars. Soft motion, magical colors, 720p.
Stylized anime brain sending a glowing pulse down a luminous spine. Smooth animation, fantasy glow, 720p.
scenes.narration: So it sends a signal to wake your body.

scenes.visual_prompt: Anime medium shot of the character relaxing again, calm face, soft dream colors, 720p.
Anime character sitting alone in a quiet room. Invisible glowing ripples move through the air. Soft colors, fantasy anime style, 720p.
Anime fantasy visualization of sound waves fading into glowing emptiness. Calm motion, pastel colors, 720p.
Surreal anime sonar-like pulses expanding in darkness. Magical glow, smooth motion, 720p.
scenes.narration: Without sound, it searches harder for danger.

scenes.visual_prompt: Anime medium shot of the character turning on soft background noise and relaxing. Warm glow returns, 720p.
